title: Mixed Event — Secret Operation Valentine's Day — Episode4 The Fourth Valentine's Day Ally

meta.Episode: Episode4 — The Fourth Valentine's Day Ally
meta.Event Outline: With Valentine's Day just on the horizon, Airi is planning a surprise for everyone to show them her gratitude. She happens to meet Saki and Emu, who both had similar ideas, and they form a Secret Valentine's Day Alliance.

rows.Line: Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Phew...
I'm done with my homework and got in some practice. Time to get ready for tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We may have a good idea what we'll be doing, but I should probably get myself ready for anything that's thrown at me...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, I have every recipe printed out, so let's start by choosing which to do first...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line:
Airi.
Huh? Are you working on stream ideas again?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, this is for something else.
I'm baking sweets with some other friends from school for Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line:
With your other friends...?
Not your idol group?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, because I'm giving mine to everybody in MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll also be helping my other friends put their surprise gifts together alongside my own!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line:
That's so nice!
Does that mean your other friends have people they want to surprise too?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
They do indeed!
We all want to give back to all those who've been there for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're all after the same thing, so I thought I should help out by teaching them how to bake sweets.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, I wouldn't be much of a friend if I didn't, would I?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line: Hehe. That's my big sister for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll be looking forward to having you help them out, so good luck!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks. I promise to make it a big success!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I'll need to see this through to the end now that I have an extra fan cheering me on!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, Rin! Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Would you mind if I asked you something right now? It has to do with chatting and communicating during talk shows...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Huh...? What are these notes for...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: W-Wait, that's...!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Homemade chocolate surprise...
Oh, is this for...!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Busted, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm baking some sweets to show my appreciation for those around me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Aha! I knew it...!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, also, this is meant to be a surprise, so can we keep this just between us...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Of course. My lips are shut!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. I hope your surprise goes over well♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, how about this?! Since you're baking sweets, can I come and watch?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll be baking with some friends, but sure, as long as you stay out of sight...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yay! Awesome!
Good luck, Airi! I'll be rooting for you!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll let you know when we get started tomorrow, so could you wait until then?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay, just don't forget!>
The next day
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for seeing me out, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So you're going out to get some stuff for your show today, right, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and we'll be hauling everything over to the Wonder Stage right after.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I plan on being home before it gets dark, but are you sure you're going to be okay being all by yourself, Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll be fine since Ichi and the others are gonna come over later!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. Then you're in good hands!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Exactly. That's why I want you to relax a little today for a change, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, point taken.
Again, I should be home before it gets too late, but be sure to call me if you need anything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll be off!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Bye!
And be careful!
A few hours later
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
During today's practice...
Oh, I almost forgot. Saki can't make it today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which means we'll be focusing on the rhythm section.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Ah, Ichika, hello there!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh? Tsukasa...?
Hello.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was told that you'd be with Saki today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I could be asking you the same.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki said that you and the others would be going over to our house later...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Did you not have plans to meet today?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, we were going to have band practice, but Saki said she couldn't make it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In fact, she said that she'd be with her family...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki... Please don't tell me that you've been lying to all of us this whole time!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
P-Please try to calm down.
I'm sure it's nothing serious...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That dessert we had yesterday was so good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure Airi will like it very much if I got her something like that for Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku, hello!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Ah, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hello to the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What brings you two here?
